articles.title: Bitcoin rally sends crypto stocks soaring as miners, treasury companies jump
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s rally above $79,000 lifted miners and treasury companies, with Canaan, Strive and Metaplanet posting double-digit gains as crypto stocks surged.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners pour billions into AI as capex outpaces revenue 15-to-1
articles.snippet: Nine public miners generated $341 million from AI and HPC operations in the first half of 2026 after spending more than $5 billion on capital assets.

articles.title: Most Americans say the Trump family’s crypto investments are not ‘appropriate’: Poll
articles.snippet: A new poll showed 63% of 1,166 Americans varied sharply along partisan lines, with a majority of Republicans saying it was appropriate for Trump and his family to invest in crypto.

articles.title: Most Americans Say Trump's Crypto Profits Cross the Line: Poll
articles.snippet: A Reuters/Ipsos survey found 63% of Americans view the Trump family's crypto profits as inappropriate, with even half of the president's fellow Republicans saying his business interests sway his decisions.

articles.title: Moderna Stock Doubles on Cancer Breakthrough: Here’s What It Means
articles.snippet: A Phase 3 win against the standard of care sent the biotech's shares up 131% and left short sellers down $4.8 billion.
